ESSENTIAL CARE AT HOME

Selected medical procedures, brought to your home.

Our home-visit team can provide a range of essential clinical procedures and follow-up care, helping patients receive appropriate support in familiar surroundings.

IV Cannulation & Medication AdministrationIV access and prescribed medication or fluid administration when clinically appropriate.
Foley Catheter Insertion, Removal & CareCatheter placement, removal and ongoing catheter care at home.
Ryle’s (NG) Tube Insertion, Removal & CareRyle’s/NG tube placement, removal and tube-related care as required.
Wound Dressing & Wound CareRoutine dressing changes and ongoing care for suitable wounds.
Suturing & Suture RemovalMinor wound suturing and removal of stitches when appropriate.
Nebulization & Oxygen SupportSelected respiratory support and nebulization as advised.
ECG Recording & Vital MonitoringECG recording and monitoring of blood pressure, pulse, temperature and SpO₂.
Blood Sample CollectionConvenient sample collection at home for selected investigations.
Post-Operative Dressing & Follow-upHome-based wound care and follow-up support after selected procedures or discharge.
Bedridden Patient Care & SupportBasic clinical monitoring, comfort care and family guidance for dependent patients.

Services are provided based on clinical assessment, patient condition, medical requirements and availability of the appropriate professional/equipment.
